title: Schoolmates in the Furnace
speaker: EZRA
caption: X! Kai! You made it too!
Help me get them clear of the machinery.
alt: X, Kai and their schoolmate Ezra help small local workers out of the cooling Furnace.

title: The launch log
speaker: KILLER KAI
caption: I can read the launch logs.
This is the meteor that hit Earthior.
alt: Kai accesses a surviving Furnace terminal while X recognizes the marked meteor in its launch record.

title: The name behind the order
speaker: X GOD
caption: Void Regent. He signed the order.
Now I have your name.
alt: X reads Void Regent's authorization on the recovered Earthior launch record.

title: The next target
speaker: TELEPORTATION C
caption: Witchwood is marked for the next strike.
Kilina's charts may show his world.
alt: Teleportation C and Kai share a recovered route chart with X, pointing toward Witchwood.
